repair_anchor.a18_cross_role_custody: Each branch has nine unique binding paths and nine unique binding SHA-256 values; target and hostile sets are disjoint; cached-L10 and history SHA-256 values are pairwise distinct across roles.

current_preservation.mechanism: immutable descriptor-authenticated inventory plus exact pre-repair validator byte copy
current_preservation.limitation: The inventory proves the old bytes and the one-path hash blast but does not by itself clear occupied canonical owner-once destinations for republication.

mandatory_pre_replay_gate.action: Independently audit, then explicitly authorize and execute, the implemented no-clobber same-filesystem retirement transaction before any canonical replay.
requirements: Rename, never delete or copy, every stale derived A01-A16 target artifact and every hostile stage-2 artifact that the fresh A01 freeze requires absent.
Authenticate path, inode, size, mode, link count, and SHA-256 before and after each rename.
Use an empty versioned obstruction-custody destination and refuse partial completion, replacement, cross-filesystem movement, links, or unregistered paths.
Fsync moved files and both source and destination parent directories, then publish an exact retirement manifest once.
Do not move frozen source files; the old validator bytes are already held separately and all unchanged sources remain in place.
mandatory_pre_replay_gate.why_required: The production publishers are owner-once and the fresh A01 freeze requires downstream target and hostile stage-2 products to be absent.

estimated_wall_hours.basis: engineering estimate; no retirement transaction has yet been executed

implementation.atomic_no_replace: macOS renameatx_np with RENAME_EXCL; destination races refuse without replacement
implementation.retained_identity: device, inode, size, mode, link count, and SHA-256 retained and compared across forward and recovery renames
implementation.moved_payload_fsync: every moved regular file recursively fsynced before both source and destination parents

target_replay.operation: Republish the V012 freeze with the repaired production-obligation-validator SHA-256 and unchanged source/dependency census.
Run the exact production mutation preflight against empty canonical downstream destinations and publish a new preflight result and mutation ledger.
target_replay.known_test_anchor: 477/477 mutation assignments and 33/33 positive fixtures passed in the non-publishing self-test execution.

target_replay.operation: Run an independent prepayload hostile audit on the new hashes, then publish the universal custody gate only after that audit passes.
Build fresh L=4,6,8,10,12 target caches. Do not reuse the old manifests because their lineage binds the old freeze hash.
Independently audit all five new cache payloads, publish the base physical gate, independently audit it, and publish control-only authorization.
Execute fresh L=4,6,8 histories, compare to the sealed controls, publish the control-stage gate, and independently audit it.
Publish L10-only authorization, execute a fresh L10 history, compare to the sealed L10 control, publish the L10 stage gate, and independently audit it.

a17_a18_replay.operation: After A16 passes, restore the byte-identical hostile V004R4 stage-2 custody set to its exact canonical paths by the inverse audited rename transaction, then independently revalidate the complete nine-source A17 projection. Regenerate the hostile branch only if that exact restoration fails validation.
a17_a18_replay.claim_boundary: Restoration does not promote A17; A17 remains an independently validated prerequisite.

a17_a18_replay.operation: Construct the old canonical-path A18 record from the newly certified target A16 projection and the independently revalidated hostile A17 projection; validate it with the repaired target sink and an independent hostile sink; publish once only if both accept identical bytes.
a17_a18_replay.claim_boundary: A18 publication certifies only exact target/hostile L10 cross-benchmark compatibility. It does not authorize L12, Gate A-P, a continuum claim, or gravity.

automation_gap.detail: The exact retirement phase now has a restart-safe dry-run/execute/recovery coordinator. The repository still lacks one audited command that republishes every A01-A18 gate/audit in dependency order after retirement.
automation_gap.shortest_fix: Add the bounded republication portion that calls only the existing validators/publishers without changing any record schema, admission criterion, physics, or solver.

estimated_wall_hours.basis: engineering estimate; coordinator implementation and independent test not yet performed

estimated_replay_wall_hours_after_indepe.basis: Measured mutation/control/L10 anchors plus engineering bounds for owner-once retirement, cache reconstruction, publishers, and independent reviews; not a guarantee.

halt_conditions: Independent hostile review rejects the repaired validator or its exact hash blast.
The retirement transaction cannot prove complete byte and inode custody without clobber or partial state.
Any fresh A01-A18 artifact fails its production validator or independent sink.
Any control history differs from its sealed deterministic reference outside frozen tolerances.
A17 cannot be restored or regenerated without a schema, criterion, physics, or solver change.
